sentences.I dag skal vi snakke mer om vær og om kl: Today we're going to talk more about weather and climate.
sentences.Hva slags klima tror dere at det er der?: What kind of climate do you think it has there?
sentences.Det er sikkert veldig kaldt der om vinte: It must be very cold there in the winter.
No, actually it isn't that cold.
sentences.Ålesund ligger ved kysten, og vi har gan: Ålesund is on the coast, and we get quite a lot of rain.
But sometimes we get loads of snow.
sentences.Er det mye snø i Polen, Monica?: Is there a lot of snow in Poland, Monica?
sentences.Ja, noen steder er det en ganske lang vi: Yes, in some places the winter is quite long, and the children can play in the snow.
But there's often rain and cold wind.
sentences.Sommeren er ganske varm mange steder, og: The summer is quite warm in many places, and we go to the beach and swim.
sentences.Hvordan er klimaet i Irak, Haifa?: What's the climate like in Iraq, Haifa?
sentences.Jo, noen steder, særlig i Vest-Irak er d: Yes, in some places, especially in western Iraq, it's very hot and dry.
sentences.Har dere ikke regntid?: Don't you have a rainy season?
sentences.Jo, vi får litt regn i perioden fra dese: Yes, we get a little rain in the period from December to March.
sentences.I Somalia har vi regntid fra april til s: In Somalia we have a rainy season from April to September, but it usually doesn't rain enough.
sentences.Jeg liker veldig godt regnet her i Norge: I really like the rain here in Norway.
sentences.Kanskje jeg skal flytte til Ålesund!: Maybe I should move to Ålesund!
